allocation_policy: All listed values are approved Development Profile allocations. None is a permanent Federation wire allocation until schemas and vectors are reviewed.

core_collision_proof.namespace_rule: Federation registries are carried only inside extension ID 1 and never interpreted as Core message, object, or error values.

core_registries.object_types: Core objects are selected by closed schema/context, not a numeric object registry

WP8-SCHEMA-REQUIREDNESS-01.required_deliverable: object-by-object genesis/update requiredness matrix and literal schema vectors

FED_CAPABILITIES.why: Advertises compatible Federation extension/object/profile/capability/bound values after the selected authenticated Core context.

FED_CAPABILITIES_ACK.why: Confirms the exact compatible Federation selection and rejects unsupported critical semantics.

OPERATOR_RECORD_QUERY.why: Requests one exact Operator Registry Record without enumeration.

OPERATOR_RECORD_RESPONSE.why: Returns the exact record or privacy-safe absence proof for the bound query.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_QUERY.why: Requests one exact Operator Endpoint Record after operator identity selection.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_RESPONSE.why: Returns endpoint candidates cryptographically bound to the requested operator.

OWNERSHIP_AUTHORITY_QUERY.why: Requests the bounded ownership and delegation chain for one service scope.

OWNERSHIP_AUTHORITY_RESPONSE.why: Returns a bounded ordered ownership/delegation chain without granting authority by delivery.

AUTHORITY_PROOF_QUERY.why: Requests one compact Federation Authority Proof for a bound bilateral context.

AUTHORITY_PROOF_RESPONSE.why: Returns the requested compact proof bound to its exact dependencies.

TRUST_BUNDLE_REQUEST.why: Requests a scoped bundle version or a newer compatible version.

TRUST_BUNDLE_RESPONSE.why: Returns the requested bundle and continuity evidence.

TRUST_BUNDLE_UPDATE.why: Pushes a newer candidate bundle with continuity and transparency evidence.

TRUST_BUNDLE_ACK.why: Acknowledges delivery and exact processing outcome without equating delivery with normative acceptance.

CHECKPOINT_QUERY.why: Requests a checkpoint at or after a bound tree size.

CHECKPOINT_RESPONSE.why: Returns the exact signed checkpoint for the query.

INCLUSION_PROOF_REQUEST.why: Requests inclusion of one exact object digest at one checkpoint.

INCLUSION_PROOF_RESPONSE.why: Returns the bounded proof for the exact object and checkpoint.

CONSISTENCY_PROOF_REQUEST.why: Requests consistency between two exact checkpoint sizes and roots.

CONSISTENCY_PROOF_RESPONSE.why: Returns the bounded proof connecting the requested checkpoints.

WITNESS_STATEMENT.why: Publishes a witness statement for one exact checkpoint and organization.

AUTHORIZATION_REQUEST.why: Requests destination authorization after independent source validation has succeeded.

AUTHORIZATION_RESPONSE.why: Returns the destination decision bound to the source-validated request without replacing source validation.

REVOCATION_PUSH.why: Pushes a typed revocation for immediate validation and selective enforcement.

REVOCATION_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact accepted or rejected revocation digest, reason, enforcement, and state result.

REVOCATION_QUERY.why: Queries current revocation state for an exact target and generation.

REVOCATION_RESPONSE.why: Returns current typed revocation state or privacy-safe absence evidence.

CONFLICT_REPORT.why: Reports retained equivocation or split-view evidence without unilateral conviction authority.

CONFLICT_ACK.why: Acknowledges receipt and exact evidence digest without deciding the conflict.

OPERATOR_STATUS_QUERY.why: Queries exact current operator lifecycle generation and recovery stage.

OPERATOR_STATUS_RESPONSE.why: Returns the exact signed lifecycle record and dependencies.

QUARANTINE_NOTICE.why: Notifies peers of quarantine evidence and required enforcement without creating authority by delivery.

RECOVERY_NOTICE.why: Notifies peers of a candidate recovery transition without activating recovered authority.

REENTRY_EVIDENCE.why: Supplies synchronization, checkpoint, revocation, monitoring, and readiness evidence for staged re-entry.

OPERATOR_REGISTRATION_REQUEST.why: Requests genesis registration under registrar and witness authority.

OPERATOR_REGISTRATION_RESPONSE.why: Returns exact registration acceptance, rejection, or pending result.

OPERATOR_RECORD_UPDATE.why: Presents a monotonic signed operator record update with continuity evidence.

OPERATOR_RECORD_UPDATE_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact operator update digest and processing result.

KEY_AUTHORIZATION_PUBLISH.why: Publishes a genesis purpose-bound key authorization.

KEY_AUTHORIZATION_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact genesis key authorization processing result.

KEY_AUTHORIZATION_UPDATE.why: Publishes a monotonic key authorization rotation or lifecycle update.

KEY_AUTHORIZATION_UPDATE_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact key update digest and processing result.

NAME_OWNERSHIP_PUBLISH.why: Publishes genesis name ownership under registry-rooted authority.

NAME_OWNERSHIP_ACK.why: Acknowledges exact ownership publication processing state.

NAME_OWNERSHIP_UPDATE.why: Publishes a monotonic ownership update or dual-authorized transfer.

NAME_OWNERSHIP_UPDATE_ACK.why: Acknowledges exact ownership update or transfer processing state.

DELEGATION_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact delegation publication result.

DELEGATION_UPDATE.why: Publishes a monotonic narrowing, expiry, or revocation-aware delegation update.

DELEGATION_UPDATE_ACK.why: Acknowledges the exact delegation update result.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_PUBLISH.why: Publishes a genesis operator-bound endpoint record.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_ACK.why: Acknowledges exact endpoint publication processing state.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_UPDATE.why: Publishes a monotonic endpoint binding or key update.

ENDPOINT_RECORD_UPDATE_ACK.why: Acknowledges exact endpoint update processing state.

CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_PUBLISH.why: Publishes threshold-authorized conflict resolution without erasing retained evidence.

CONFLICT_RESOLUTION_ACK.why: Acknowledges exact conflict resolution processing state.

APPEAL_REQUEST.why: Requests appeal review separately from recovery and without reactivating authority.

APPEAL_RESPONSE.why: Returns a threshold-authorized appeal decision that cannot override terminal non-reactivation rules.

VERIFIED.meaning: identity verified; provisioning not yet authorized

ACTIVE.meaning: normal accepted authority subject to all dependencies

SUSPENDED.meaning: new use denied under suspension policy

REJECTED.meaning: application rejected; creates no federation authority
